annotations.title: Irish used-car inventory by county and make, with turnover and freshness

description: Use for market coverage and supply analysis: active used-car listings, optionally for one county and/or make, with a county and make breakdown, listings added in the last 24 hours, listings removed in the last 7 days, number of sources and when the data was last refreshed. Counts only; no prices. Use get_inventory_summary instead when you only need the one headline active-listing count. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

country.description: Market to query: IE = Ireland (default), GB = UK including Northern Ireland, ALL = both. Prices are always also given in EUR (GBP converted at the live ECB rate).

county.description: Optional Irish county, e.g. Dublin, Cork, Galway (case-insensitive).

name: get_inventory_breakdown
title: Irish used-car inventory by county and make, with turnover and freshness
